title: MDF 402 Payment Required response body
description: Normative description of the JSON body a server emits with a 402 Payment Required response to an Accept: text/markdown request. Describes what a server emits; it does not constrain what a consumer does with it.

mdf_version.description: MDF version this response conforms to.

resource.description: Absolute URL of the resource being priced. Echoes the requested URL.

auth_endpoint.description: Present when payment at this price tier issues a bearer credential rather than delivering content immediately.

token_estimate.description: Optional heuristic token estimate. Never authoritative. If present, token_estimate_note MUST also be present.

token_estimate_note.description: Description of the estimation method, e.g. 'chars/4 approximation'.

byteCount.description: A byte length. Bounded to reject implausible values.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string, to avoid float representation error. Non-negative.

currency.description: Currency or asset symbol, e.g. USDC, BTC. Null for zero-price responses.

chain.description: Settlement network, e.g. base, ethereum, lightning.

rail.description: Payment rail this offer is denominated in. Consumers encountering an unrecognised value are expected to decline rather than attempt it.

endpoint.description: Where payment is submitted or verified. SHOULD be same-origin with `resource`; see notes in CONCEPT.md.

recipient.description: Rail-specific payee identifier: EVM address for x402, node pubkey or LSP identifier for l402.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp after which this offer is no longer valid.

nonce.description: Opaque value binding a subsequent payment proof to this specific offer.

macaroon.description: L402 only. Bearer credential presented alongside the payment preimage.

reduction_pct.description: (1 - markdown_bytes / source_bytes) * 100, one decimal place. May be negative where conversion increases size.
